artifacts.summary: Activated the parked Playwright MCP design in web-implementation-agent.md, reconciled the drifted tool list (browser_verify_text_visible -> browser_find/browser_wait_for) against the real 24-tool server, and added a new playwright-mcp-guide.md context file covering the unprompted/prompting permission split and when-to-drive-a-browser guidance.

partial_progress.details: All source-store edits made and verified; report written

memory_candidates.content: When a Playwright (or similar) MCP server intentionally splits its tool surface into an always-allow safe tier and a prompting unsafe tier, that split must be mirrored consistently across every file that names the tool list: the settings-fragment.json allowlist enumeration, any context-file tool reference table, and any agent-file 'unprompted tools' bullet. None of these wildcard as the server's tool surface grows, so a server upgrade requires a coordinated edit across all of them, not just the settings fragment. See agent-system/extensions/web/settings-fragment.json, agent-system/extensions/web/context/project/web/tools/playwright-mcp-guide.md, and agent-system/extensions/web/agents/web-implementation-agent.md as the worked three-way example.

check-extension-docs.sh refuses to run from the agent-system source-store tree (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/) with an explicit error explaining that its relative '../..' path resolution assumes a deployed .claude/scripts/ or .opencode/scripts/ location. A source-store-only edit session cannot self-verify with this lint; a deploy-then-relint pass is a separate follow-up step, not something achievable in the same session as the source edits.
